tags.name: ui-tabs
tags.description: Timeless `ui-tabs`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Tabs pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: activation
attributes.description: Whether moving focus with the arrow keys selects the tab immediately (`automatic`) or waits for Enter or Space (`manual`). Use `manual` when selecting a tab is expensive. Defaults to `automatic`. Exported as `tabsActivations`.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Arrow-key axis. Mirrored onto `aria-orientation` on the tablist during enhancement. Defaults to `horizontal`. Exported as `tabsOrientations`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The tab selected on load and after a form reset. Match a tab’s `value` attribute. Assign the `value` property for live changes.

tags.name: ui-dialog
tags.description: Timeless `ui-dialog`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Modal Dialog pattern.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Whether the panel is a regular dialog or an alert dialog. `alert` resolves to `role="alertdialog"`, for a destructive confirmation the user must answer. Defaults to `dialog`. Exported as `dialogKinds`.

tags.name: ui-sheet
tags.description: Timeless `ui-sheet`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Modal Dialog pattern. Dispatches `ui-open`, `ui-close`, `ui-dismiss`.

attributes.name: modal
attributes.description: Present to open the sheet as a modal, trapping focus and blocking the page behind it. Omit for a non-modal sheet the user can interact around. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Present to render the sheet open on load. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Which viewport edge the sheet slides in from. Defaults to `right`. Exported as `sheetPositions`.

tags.name: ui-popover
tags.description: Timeless `ui-popover`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Disclosure pattern.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Positioning uses CSS anchor positioning, so the browser may flip the surface to keep it on screen. Defaults to `bottom`. Exported as `floatingPlacements`.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Semantics applied to the surface, and the `aria-haspopup` value set on the trigger. Choose it from the interaction, not the appearance. Defaults to `dialog`. Exported as `popoverRoles`.

tags.name: ui-hover-card
tags.description: Timeless `ui-hover-card`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Tooltip pattern.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: Id of an element to anchor against instead of the trigger. Use it when the visual anchor differs from the control that opens the card.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Set `tooltip` for the compact tooltip treatment. Omit for the roomier hover-card surface. Exported as `hoverCardVariants`.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side of the anchor. Defaults to `bottom`. Exported as `floatingPlacements`.

attributes.name: open-delay
attributes.description: Milliseconds of hover or focus intent before opening. The resolved number is available on the read-only `openDelay` property. Defaults to `180`.

attributes.name: close-delay
attributes.description: Milliseconds after the pointer leaves before closing, so the user can cross the gap into the surface. The resolved number is available on the read-only `closeDelay` property. Defaults to `100`.

tags.name: ui-menu
tags.description: Timeless `ui-menu`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Menu and Menubar pattern.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Arrow-key axis. Defaults to `horizontal` when the menu part is `role="menubar"`. Defaults to `vertical`. Exported as `menuOrientations`.

tags.name: ui-menu-button
tags.description: Timeless `ui-menu-button`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Menu Button pattern. Dispatches `ui-open`, `ui-close`.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Present to render the menu open on load. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Defaults to `bottom`. Exported as `floatingPlacements`.

tags.name: ui-toolbar
tags.description: Timeless `ui-toolbar`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Toolbar pattern.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Arrow-key axis across the toolbar controls. Defaults to `horizontal`. Exported as `toolbarOrientations`.

tags.name: ui-radio-group
tags.description: Timeless `ui-radio-group`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Radio Group pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout and arrow-key axis. Defaults to `vertical`. Exported as `choiceGroupOrientations`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The radio checked on load and after a form reset. Match one input’s `value`. Assign the `value` property for live changes.

tags.name: ui-checkbox-group
tags.description: Timeless `ui-checkbox-group`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Checkbox pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout and arrow-key axis. Defaults to `vertical`. Exported as `choiceGroupOrientations`.

tags.name: ui-listbox
tags.description: Timeless `ui-listbox`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Listbox pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`, `ui-page`.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Present to allow more than one selected option, submitting one form entry per value under the same `name`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The option selected on load and after a form reset. Assign the `value` property for live changes; once the user commits a change the attribute stops applying, the way it does on a native input.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. The element submits its own value through `ElementInternals`.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Present to block submission while nothing is selected, with `valueMissing`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Present to disable the control. A control inside a disabled `<fieldset>` is disabled too, and submits nothing either way. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Options to render per page. Absent means unpaged, which is the default and adds no pager. The resolved number is available on the read-only `pageCount` property.

tags.name: ui-select
tags.description: Timeless `ui-select`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Select-Only Combobox pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`, `ui-open`, `ui-close`, `ui-input`, `ui-page`.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Present to render the listbox open on load. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side of the trigger for the listbox surface. Defaults to `bottom`. Exported as `floatingPlacements`.

attributes.name: searchable
attributes.description: Present to filter from a `search` field inside the surface. Focus moves into that field on open and stays there; the highlight travels through `aria-activedescendant`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The option selected on load and after a form reset. Once the user commits a change the attribute stops applying, the way it does on a native input.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Which edge of the trigger the surface aligns to. The surface is never narrower than the trigger. Defaults to `start`. Exported as `collectionAlignments`.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: How typed text narrows the options. `off` hands visibility to you: listen for `ui-input` and set `hidden` yourself, and navigation, the empty state, group collapse, and paging all follow. Defaults to `contains`. Exported as `optionFilterModes`.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Present to allow more than one selected option. Selected values render as chips and submit one form entry each under the same `name`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. The element submits its own value through `ElementInternals`.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Present to block submission while nothing is selected, with `valueMissing`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Present to disable the control. A control inside a disabled `<fieldset>` is disabled too, and submits nothing either way. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Options to render per page. Absent means unpaged, which is the default and adds no pager. The resolved number is available on the read-only `pageCount` property.

tags.name: ui-combobox
tags.description: Timeless `ui-combobox`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Combobox pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`, `ui-open`, `ui-close`, `ui-input`, `ui-page`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The option selected on load and after a form reset. Once the user commits a change the attribute stops applying, the way it does on a native input.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Which edge of the trigger the surface aligns to. The surface is never narrower than the trigger. Defaults to `start`. Exported as `collectionAlignments`.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: How typed text narrows the options. `off` hands visibility to you: listen for `ui-input` and set `hidden` yourself, and navigation, the empty state, group collapse, and paging all follow. Defaults to `contains`. Exported as `optionFilterModes`.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Present to allow more than one selected option. Selected values render as chips and submit one form entry each under the same `name`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. The element submits its own value through `ElementInternals`.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Present to block submission while nothing is selected, with `valueMissing`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Present to disable the control. A control inside a disabled `<fieldset>` is disabled too, and submits nothing either way. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Options to render per page. Absent means unpaged, which is the default and adds no pager. The resolved number is available on the read-only `pageCount` property.

tags.name: ui-toaster
tags.description: Timeless `ui-toaster`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Corner or edge of the viewport the toasts stack against. Defaults to `bottom-end`. Exported as `toasterPlacements`.

attributes.name: stack
attributes.description: Whether queued toasts overlap into a deck (`overlap`) or lay out as a full list (`list`). Defaults to `overlap`. Exported as `toasterStacks`.

tags.name: ui-toast
tags.description: Timeless `ui-toast`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Dispatches `ui-dismiss`.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds before the toast dismisses itself. `0` keeps it open until dismissed. Defaults to `5000`.

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: Present to disable auto-dismiss regardless of `duration`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

tags.name: ui-toggle-group
tags.description: Timeless `ui-toggle-group`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Button pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: attached
attributes.description: Present to join the buttons into one segmented control. Styling only, resolved by `toggle.css`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout and arrow-key axis. Defaults to `horizontal`. Exported as `toggleGroupOrientations`.

attributes.name: selection
attributes.description: Whether pressing one button releases the others (`single`) or toggles independently (`multiple`). Defaults to `single`. Exported as `toggleGroupSelections`.

tags.name: ui-number-stepper
tags.description: Timeless `ui-number-stepper`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Dispatches `input`, `change`.

tags.name: ui-color-picker
tags.description: Timeless `ui-color-picker`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Dispatches `input`, `change`.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Color space the channel controls edit and the raw input round-trips through. The picker converts the current value when this changes. Defaults to `oklch`. Exported as `colorPickerFormats`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial and form-reset color, in any CSS color syntax. Unlike the collection elements, the picker reflects one `value` property rather than a separate authored default.

tags.name: ui-form
tags.description: Timeless `ui-form`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Form errors pattern. Dispatches `ui-invalid`.

tags.name: ui-range-field
tags.description: Timeless `ui-range-field`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Slider (Multi-Thumb) pattern. Dispatches `ui-change`.

tags.name: ui-otp-field
tags.description: Timeless `ui-otp-field`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA One-time code pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`, `ui-complete`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. The joined code submits as one entry through `ElementInternals`; the cells themselves carry no `name`.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: How many characters the code has. Defaults to the number of authored cells, and is what a partly filled field is measured against.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The code on load and after a form reset. Assign the `value` property for live changes; once the user types, the attribute stops applying, the way it does on a native input.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Present to block submission while the field is empty, with `valueMissing`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Present to disable the field. A field inside a disabled `<fieldset>` is disabled too, and submits nothing either way. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

globalAttributes.name: data-ui-part
globalAttributes.description: Whitespace-separated list of anatomy part names, selected with `[data-ui-part~='name']`. Each part belongs to its nearest component root.
